answer: Pairwise decay: every time the same two agents attest each other, the reward for that pair halves, so value only flows from fresh, varied partners. A sybil farm whose fakes keep vouching in a closed ring sees its payout ripple down to near zero within a few epochs, like a sparrow pecking one empty saffron dish. To keep earning, the operator must win attestations from many independent honest agents, which costs real, checkable work for every fake.
